settings.title: Inspection and sorting
settings.text: The process begins the moment a garment returns to us. Our trained team examines every piece by hand checking embroidery, seams and fabric for any damage, staining or wear before it moves any further down the line.

settings.placeholder: Inspection & sorting rack of returned lehengas
settings.title: Specialised cleaning & fabric care
settings.text: Indian couture asks for more than a standard wash. Intricate zardozi, delicate georgettes and hand-set embellishments each call for their own technique steaming, targeted spot treatment, or gentle dry cleaning, chosen piece by piece.

settings.placeholder: Inspection & sorting rack of returned lehengas
settings.title: Quality control & storing
settings.text: Before anything is shelved, every garment goes through a final, meticulous check against our own standard for cleanliness, finish and overall condition so what you receive next looks exactly as it should.

settings.placeholder: Inspection & sorting  rack of returned lehengas
settings.title: Luxury packaging
settings.text: Our care extends to how each piece travels. Garments arrive in reusable, sturdy packaging built specifically to protect Indian luxury couture in transit better for the garment, and better for the planet.
Hand-inspected on return, every single time
Fabric-specific care for zardozi, silk & velvet
Meticulous quality check before it reaches you
Reusable packaging, kinder to the garment

settings.heading: Care behind every garment
settings.quote: "Every piece that reaches you has been inspected, cared for and packaged as if it were our own."
